operations.new_text: Since immutable FINAL-in members retain c=beta_c, a nonempty frozen W has mean beta_c; reaching that mean does not imply a later gate entrant is FINAL-in, because c may be capped after a nonpreferred streak. Recheck the existing freeze predicate after entry.

operations.old_text: Silent peers abstain, so each round's effective sample is the peers that answered.
operations.new_text: Silent peers abstain; each item's quorum remains alpha of the captured K sampled peers.

operations.old_text: The response assumption is that answering is independent of whether a peer is adversarial, so adversaries remain at most a beta share of answerers in expectation.
operations.new_text: Independence of answering and adversarial identity is an evaluation/liveness assumption, not a change to the quorum.

operations.old_text: Violations, such as selectively silencing honest peers, are outside the guarantee.
operations.new_text: Selective silence or response delays can prevent quorum success and must be evaluated.

operations.old_text: This is not a hard per-round fraction bound.
operations.new_text: No hard per-round adversarial fraction among answerers is enforced.

operations.old_text: The core cannot enforce the response assumption.
operations.new_text: The core cannot enforce independence of responses.

operations.old_text: Minimize n/P_hat(n), ties to smaller n.
operations.new_text: Minimize n/P_hat(n), treating positive n divided by zero as +infinity for this comparison; ties go to smaller n, including when every candidate has infinite cost.
